repo:objectstack#1 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgUkbQqRUUFSiu2HGob

Seat reading · 2026-11-20T19:11Z · Where #35889 and this card meet: a master-detail child that a parent field group places in the overview, on an object that DECLARES `relatedLists` without listing that child.

- #35889 item 4 (a group-placed table keeps its tab with a count) is the rule for the DEFAULT page, where the object declares no `relatedLists`.
- This card makes a declared `relatedLists` the tab list: visibility and order. So when `relatedLists` is declared, it decides the tabs: an unlisted child gets no tab. The group still places its table in the overview.
- Under this reading the two cards do not contradict each other, so it is not a fork for the maintainer. The seat will raise it with the maintainer if they read it differently.

Owed on the head that has #35921 merged in (PR #35923): `deriveRelatedLists` / `arrangeDeclaredTabs` stop appending an unlisted group-placed body table as a trailing tab when `relatedLists` is declared, and one test pins both cases (declared: no tab, table in overview; not declared: tab with count, per #35889 item 4).
